sources.citation: Borise, Lena & Xavier Zientarski. 2018. Word stress and phrase accent in Georgian. Proc. 6th International Symposium on Tonal Aspects of Languages (TAL 2018), Berlin, 18-20 June 2018. ISCA Archive.
sources.quote: MODERN Georgian instrumental pilot: fixed initial, duration-cued word stress; the traditional antepenult/penult 'stress' in longer words is a phrasal pitch target, not word stress.
sources.locator: Abstract p.1; §2.2-2.3; §4 Conclusion ('Georgian has fixed initial stress that is primarily duration-based.. There is no evidence.. for a similar duration-based stress-like target on the antepenultimate/penultimate syllable. Instead, it is a pitch target that is part of the prosodic makeup of a phrase.')
